Class TripSchedule

java.lang.Object
TripSchedule
public class TripSchedule extends Object
Class TripSchedule Responsible for building a trip plan based on selected attractions, travel time, opening hours, and time constraints. Uses a greedy nearest-neighbour strategy to create a schedule.
